name: MEGA·2 CUSTOMER LIFECYCLE BRAIN — omni-intake AI + voice-reply + sale→loyalty + daily lifecycle engine (bridal/occasions/follow-ups)

parameters.content:
# 🧠 MEGA·2 — CUSTOMER LIFECYCLE BRAIN
Every customer touchpoint, one workflow, four sections.

**A · OMNI-INTAKE (webhook `omni-in`)** — every channel POSTs here {channel, from, name, message}: website chat, ManyChat (IG/FB), WhatsApp relay. Gemini detects language+intent+sentiment → replies from YOUR facts → logs → angry = human escalation.
**B · VOICE IN, VOICE OUT (Telegram)** — customer voice note forwarded to the bot → Gemini transcribes (Kannada/Hindi/English) + drafts answer → **ElevenLabs speaks the reply** → you get BOTH text + ready voice reply to forward. A jeweller that answers in spoken Kannada = magic.
**C · SALE → LOYALTY (webhook `sale-in`)** — every bill: points (1/₹100), Silver→Gold→Platinum tiers, referral bonus, thank-you + review ask scheduled (+3d via FollowUps tab).
**D · DAILY LIFECYCLE ENGINE (9:00)** — one timer drives: overdue follow-ups & escalations · bridal T-drip (180/90/60/30/7/+15, AI-personalised) · birthday/anniversary nudges · scheduled review-asks. Everything lands as one-tap wa.me links on your Telegram.

**KEYS:** GEMINI_API_KEY · ELEVENLABS_API_KEY + VOICE_ID · TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID · BRAND_NAME · FAQ_TEXT (paste your policies!) · Sheets tabs: Enquiries, CareLog, Loyalty, Bridal, Customers, FollowUps.

**🔧 FIX:** empty AI replies → FAQ_TEXT unset · voice reply silent → check ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID is multilingual-v2 capable · duplicates in drip → LastTouch column does the guarding.
